title: Stress test fails for callable bonds
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Reported by Daniel Okafor (Risk manager).

In the +100 basis points scenario, callable bonds are repriced to maturity, so losses are overstated by roughly 0.2% at the portfolio level for Bayview. This matters because the proposed Q4 rebalance sits at -3.4% against the -3.5% limit.

Expected: callable bonds repriced with an option-adjusted model.

Next steps: Maria Delgado to supply option-adjusted convexity inputs; Priya Natarajan to integrate for DuraLens v0.4.
